Method of Attack: Exploitation of Citrix Bleed vulnerability (CVE-2023-4966) using publicly available exploits to breach systems, steal data, and encrypt files
Impacted Systems: Large organizations using vulnerable Citrix Netscaler devices
Attack Vector: Publicly available exploit targeting Citrix Netscaler devices
Discoverer: Kevin Beaumont (for LockBit attacks exploiting Citrix Bleed)
